description.narrative: IFC is considering an equity investment of up to US$6 million, processed under the IFC Startup Catalyst Program (ISC), in Africa Seed Fund Coöperatief U.A. (Flat6Labs Africa or the Fund), a Netherlands-based accelerator and VC fund focusing on pre-Seed/Seed stage investments in North, West, and East Africa. The Fund has a target size of US$85 million. The Fund will be managed by Flat6Labs For Financial Consulting S.A.E. (Flat6Labs or the Fund Manager). The Fund will be supported by the Blended Finance Facility (BFF) of the Women Entrepreneurs Finance Initiative (WeFi).

The Fund is expected to increase access to seed and early-stage venture capital financing and value creation services for digital entrepreneurs in Africa. A material share of investees is expected to have a woman co-founder, thereby addressing gender divides in access to capital in the region. The project is also expected to contribute to create a competitive digital entrepreneurship ecosystem in Africa, by supporting the development of local VC markets, via demonstration and replication, enabling frameworks, and capacity building channels.
